subject: Civil Engineering
title: Contract Types
description: Learn Contract Types in one minute.

hook.text: Who takes the financial risk — the owner or the contractor? The contract type decides.

buildup.text: Lump sum contracts fix the price — the contractor absorbs overruns but keeps savings.

discovery.text: Cost-plus contracts reimburse actual costs plus a fee — the owner takes cost risk.

twist.text: Guaranteed maximum price (GMP) caps cost-plus — the contractor covers overruns above the cap.

climax.text: Unit price contracts pay per quantity — ideal when exact quantities are unknown, like excavation.

punchline.text: The contract is a bet on risk. Who pays for the unknown decides the game.

quiz.question: In a lump sum contract, who bears the risk of cost overruns?
options: The owner pays any additional costs beyond the original estimate
The contractor absorbs all cost overruns since the price is fixed
The risk is shared equally between the owner and contractor
